propositions: A ticket declaring file_impact_scope: none must be validated to ensure the declared no-file-impact assertion is correct and the plan actually requires no repository-file edits.

The no-file-impact criterion must apply deterministically only when persisted scope is exactly 'none'; other values (paths, undeclared, missing, None, unknown) must not trigger the criterion or incur LLM cost.
The criterion must carry the persisted no_file_impact_reason into Pass-1 as deterministic structured context so the LLM can assess whether the declared reason is grounded and plausible.
A false or vague no-file-impact declaration must produce an advisory contradiction or insufficient-coaching finding that does not block claim, preserving drift protection.
Documentation changes are not compatible with no-file-impact scope, while reading or analysing repository code without editing remains compatible.
The criterion must be registered in the canonical routing table with its applicability predicate and 0.95 advisory threshold, auto-discoverable by the prompt scan without manual index edits.
